summary: The filing is a Form 6-K from OceanPal Inc. reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 16, 2026. Shareholders approved the election of two Class II directors, an amendment to the articles of incorporation to change the company's name from OceanPal Inc. to SVRN, Inc., and the appointment of CBIZ CPAs P.C. as independent auditors for FY2026. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or going-private event is described. The filing is purely a routine corporate governance update and does not meet any special-situations category.
